```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(mice)
library(WeightIt)
library(cobalt)

options(scipen = 999)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PURPOSE
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Primary weighting analysis:
#   1. Start from the final 20-imputation MICE object.
#   2. Estimate ATT entropy-balancing weights separately in each completed
#      dataset.
#   3. Balance covariate means/proportions (mean-only entropy balancing).
#   4. Diagnose weight stability, ESS, SMDs, variance ratios, and KS balance.
#   5. Save weighted datasets and diagnostics.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# - Parents are the focal/treated group.
# - Parent ATT weights are 1.
# - Controls are reweighted to resemble parents.
# - No trimming, capping, or support restriction is performed here.
# - Second-moment entropy balancing is NOT used in the primary analysis.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

IMP_PATH <- here("data", "derived", "mice_imp_final.rds")
OUTPUT_DIR <- here("data", "derived")

stopifnot(file.exists(IMP_PATH))

imp <- readRDS(IMP_PATH)

stopifnot(
  inherits(imp, "mids"),
  imp$m == 20L,
  imp$iteration == 20L
)

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Loaded final MICE object.\n")
cat("Imputations:", imp$m, "\n")
cat("Iterations:", imp$iteration, "\n")
```

## 1. Weighting specification

The estimand is the **average treatment effect among treated couples (ATT)**, where the treated/focal group is couples who became parents. The same 23 baseline covariates are balanced in every imputed dataset.

```{r}
ATT_FORMULA <- group_w ~
  hinc +
  hgowner +
  size +
  smallspace +
  livedhere +
  east +
  hhgr +
  rel_duration +
  syear +
  M_age +
  M_life_sat +
  M_germborn +
  M_migration +
  M_germcitz +
  M_employment +
  M_edu_level +
  F_age +
  F_life_sat +
  F_germborn +
  F_migration +
  F_germcitz +
  F_employment +
  F_edu_level

covariates <- all.vars(ATT_FORMULA)[-1]

stopifnot(
  length(covariates) == 23L,
  !anyDuplicated(covariates)
)

print(ATT_FORMULA)
cat("Number of baseline covariates:", length(covariates), "\n")
```

## 2. Helper functions

```{r}
effective_n <- function(w) {
  (sum(w)^2) / sum(w^2)
}

get_balance_table <- function(balance_object, imp_number) {
  balance_object$Balance %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("component") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      imp = imp_number,
      is_polynomial_term = grepl("²|\\^2", component),
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

## 3. Complete all 20 imputed datasets

```{r}
completed_list <- complete(imp, action = "all")

stopifnot(length(completed_list) == 20L)

for (i in seq_along(completed_list)) {
  d <- completed_list[[i]]

  stopifnot(
    nrow(d) == 1602L,
    !anyNA(d[, c("group", covariates)])
  )
}

cat("PASS: all 20 completed datasets contain 1602 couples and no missing weighting covariates.\n")
```

## 4. Estimate mean-only entropy-balancing ATT weights

```{r}
ebal_models <- vector("list", length = imp$m)
ebal_weighted_datasets <- vector("list", length = imp$m)
weight_diagnostics_list <- vector("list", length = imp$m)
balance_tables <- vector("list", length = imp$m)
warning_tables <- vector("list", length = imp$m)

for (i in seq_len(imp$m)) {

  d <- completed_list[[i]] %>%
    mutate(
      group_num = as.numeric(as.character(group))
    )

  stopifnot(
    all(sort(unique(d$group_num)) %in% c(0, 1)),
    sum(d$group_num == 1) == 709L,
    sum(d$group_num == 0) == 893L
  )

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      group_w = factor(
        group_num,
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("control", "parent")
      )
    )

  fit_warnings <- character(0)

  w <- withCallingHandlers(
    weightit(
      ATT_FORMULA,
      data = d,
      method = "ebal",
      estimand = "ATT",
      focal = "parent"
    ),
    warning = function(warning_condition) {
      fit_warnings <<- c(
        fit_warnings,
        conditionMessage(warning_condition)
      )
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  ww <- w$weights

  stopifnot(
    length(ww) == nrow(d),
    all(is.finite(ww)),
    all(ww > 0)
  )

  parent_w <- ww[d$group_w == "parent"]
  control_w <- ww[d$group_w == "control"]

  parent_weight_deviation <- max(abs(parent_w - 1))

  b <- cobalt::bal.tab(
    w,
    un = TRUE,
    stats = c("m", "v", "ks"),
    s.d.denom = "pooled",
    continuous = "std",
    binary = "std",
    poly = 2
  )

  bal <- get_balance_table(b, imp_number = i)

  bal_original <- bal %>%
    filter(!is_polynomial_term)

  bal_poly <- bal %>%
    filter(is_polynomial_term)

  weight_diagnostics_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    imp = i,
    n_parent = sum(d$group_w == "parent"),
    n_control = sum(d$group_w == "control"),
    parent_weight_min = min(parent_w),
    parent_weight_max = max(parent_w),
    parent_weight_max_abs_deviation_from_1 = parent_weight_deviation,
    parent_ESS = effective_n(parent_w),
    control_ESS = effective_n(control_w),
    control_min = min(control_w),
    control_median = median(control_w),
    control_mean = mean(control_w),
    control_p90 = quantile(control_w, 0.90),
    control_p95 = quantile(control_w, 0.95),
    control_p99 = quantile(control_w, 0.99),
    control_max = max(control_w),
    n_control_gt_5 = sum(control_w > 5),
    n_control_gt_10 = sum(control_w > 10),
    n_control_gt_20 = sum(control_w > 20),
    max_abs_SMD_original = max(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_SMD_gt_05 = sum(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj) > 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_SMD_gt_10 = sum(abs(bal_original$Diff.Adj) > 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_KS_original = max(bal_original$KS.Adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original_KS_gt_10 = sum(bal_original$KS.Adj > 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_SMD_polynomial = ifelse(
      nrow(bal_poly) == 0,
      NA_real_,
      max(abs(bal_poly$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    max_KS_polynomial = ifelse(
      nrow(bal_poly) == 0,
      NA_real_,
      max(bal_poly$KS.Adj, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    n_warnings = length(fit_warnings)
  )

  warning_tables[[i]] <- tibble(
    imp = i,
    warning_text = ifelse(
      length(fit_warnings) == 0,
      NA_character_,
      paste(unique(fit_warnings), collapse = " | ")
    )
  )

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      .imp = i,
      att_weight_ebal = ww,
      .before = 1
    )

  ebal_models[[i]] <- w
  ebal_weighted_datasets[[i]] <- d
  balance_tables[[i]] <- bal
}
```

## 5. Weight diagnostics across imputations

```{r}
ebal_diagnostics <- bind_rows(weight_diagnostics_list)
ebal_warnings <- bind_rows(warning_tables)

print(ebal_diagnostics, n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat(
  "\nEntropy-balancing warnings across all imputations:",
  sum(ebal_diagnostics$n_warnings),
  "\n"
)

if (any(ebal_diagnostics$n_warnings > 0)) {
  print(
    ebal_warnings %>% filter(!is.na(warning_text)),
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )
}
```

## 6. Across-imputation diagnostic summary

```{r}
ebal_diagnostic_summary <- ebal_diagnostics %>%
  summarise(
    min_control_ESS = min(control_ESS),
    median_control_ESS = median(control_ESS),
    max_control_ESS = max(control_ESS),
    min_control_median_weight = min(control_median),
    median_control_median_weight = median(control_median),
    max_control_median_weight = max(control_median),
    median_control_p95 = median(control_p95),
    max_control_p95 = max(control_p95),
    median_control_p99 = median(control_p99),
    max_control_p99 = max(control_p99),
    max_control_weight = max(control_max),
    max_n_control_gt_5 = max(n_control_gt_5),
    max_n_control_gt_10 = max(n_control_gt_10),
    max_n_control_gt_20 = max(n_control_gt_20),
    max_parent_weight_deviation = max(parent_weight_max_abs_deviation_from_1),
    max_original_abs_SMD = max(max_abs_SMD_original),
    max_original_n_SMD_gt_05 = max(n_original_SMD_gt_05),
    max_original_n_SMD_gt_10 = max(n_original_SMD_gt_10),
    max_original_KS = max(max_KS_original),
    max_original_n_KS_gt_10 = max(n_original_KS_gt_10),
    max_polynomial_abs_SMD = max(max_abs_SMD_polynomial, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_polynomial_KS = max(max_KS_polynomial, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_warnings = sum(n_warnings)
  )

print(ebal_diagnostic_summary, width = Inf)
```

## 7. Detailed balance tables

```{r}
ebal_balance_long <- bind_rows(balance_tables)

worst_original_smd <- ebal_balance_long %>%
  filter(!is_polynomial_term) %>%
  mutate(abs_Diff_Adj = abs(Diff.Adj)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_Diff_Adj)) %>%
  select(
    imp,
    component,
    Diff.Un,
    Diff.Adj,
    V.Ratio.Un,
    V.Ratio.Adj,
    KS.Un,
    KS.Adj
  )

print(
  worst_original_smd %>% slice_head(n = 30),
  n = 30,
  width = Inf
)

worst_original_ks <- ebal_balance_long %>%
  filter(!is_polynomial_term) %>%
  arrange(desc(KS.Adj)) %>%
  select(
    imp,
    component,
    Diff.Adj,
    V.Ratio.Adj,
    KS.Adj
  )

print(
  worst_original_ks %>% slice_head(n = 30),
  n = 30,
  width = Inf
)
```

## 8. Relationship-duration support diagnostic

This does **not** alter the primary weights. It documents the known support issue: controls were anchored within 0–5 years of cohabitation, whereas some parent couples have baseline relationship durations above 5 years.

```{r}
relationship_support <- map_dfr(
  ebal_weighted_datasets,
  function(d) {
    i <- unique(d$.imp)

    d %>%
      group_by(group_num) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        min_rel_duration = min(rel_duration),
        median_rel_duration = median(rel_duration),
        max_rel_duration = max(rel_duration),
        n_rel_duration_gt_5 = sum(rel_duration > 5),
        prop_rel_duration_gt_5 = mean(rel_duration > 5),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        imp = i,
        group_label = ifelse(group_num == 1, "parent", "control"),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

print(relationship_support, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

## 9. Save primary entropy-ATT objects

```{r}
ebal_att_long <- bind_rows(ebal_weighted_datasets)

saveRDS(
  ebal_models,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_models.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  ebal_weighted_datasets,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_datasets.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  ebal_att_long,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_long.rds")
)

write_csv(
  ebal_diagnostics,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_diagnostics_by_imputation.csv")
)

write_csv(
  ebal_diagnostic_summary,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_diagnostic_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  ebal_balance_long,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_balance_long.csv")
)

write_csv(
  relationship_support,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_relationship_support.csv")
)

write_csv(
  ebal_warnings,
  here("data", "derived", "ebal_att_warnings.csv")
)

cat("\nSaved primary entropy-ATT objects and diagnostics to data/derived/.\n")
```

## 10. Final summary

```{r}
cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("07b PRIMARY ENTROPY-ATT SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n")

cat("Imputations:", nrow(ebal_diagnostics), "\n")
cat("Total weighting warnings:", sum(ebal_diagnostics$n_warnings), "\n")
cat("Minimum control ESS:", min(ebal_diagnostics$control_ESS), "\n")
cat("Median control ESS:", median(ebal_diagnostics$control_ESS), "\n")
cat("Maximum control weight:", max(ebal_diagnostics$control_max), "\n")
cat(
  "Largest original-variable |SMD| after weighting:",
  max(ebal_diagnostics$max_abs_SMD_original),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Largest number of original variables/components with |SMD| > .10:",
  max(ebal_diagnostics$n_original_SMD_gt_10),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Largest original-variable KS statistic after weighting:",
  max(ebal_diagnostics$max_KS_original),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Largest number of original variables/components with KS > .10:",
  max(ebal_diagnostics$n_original_KS_gt_10),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Maximum deviation of a parent ATT weight from 1:",
  max(ebal_diagnostics$parent_weight_max_abs_deviation_from_1),
  "\n"
)
cat("====================================\n")

cat("\nNo trimming, weight capping, or relationship-duration restriction was applied.\n")
cat("Review the across-imputation balance and weight diagnostics before locking 07b.\n")
```
